event.summary: Implemented configurable bounded exponential retry policy in jobrunner. RetryConfig gained max_delay_ms and retry_delay_ms() computes base*2^i saturating at max_delay_ms with overflow-free arithmetic (doubling loop + guarded shift; verified at u64::MAX and u32::MAX exponent). RetryError::is_transient() now classifies correctly. run_job retries only transient errors (permanent return immediately), counts max_attempts including the first call, sleeps retry_delay_ms(failures-1), returns last error when exhausted; public signature unchanged. Added 8 lib unit tests, 6 config unit tests, 2 error unit tests, and 4 integration tests in tests/retry_policy.rs; updated README with policy docs and example. Checks: cargo fmt --check (0), clippy -D warnings (0), cargo test --all-targets (20 passed); trusted verification jobrunner.exact and rust.workspace both passed (16 unit + 4 integration + doc-tests, exit 0). Reviewed diff: only README.md, src/config.rs, src/error.rs, src/lib.rs modified plus new tests/retry_policy.rs; no leftover TODOs.
